scope: Proposition 6.2 (Decay of a routed unit flow) of the manuscript “Spontaneous magnetization in the quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet” (preprints/Spontaneous-magnetization-in-the-quantum-Heisenberg-ferromagnet-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 271 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8c9083e5eb7a9d6f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 35. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let d ≥ 3, ν = 1/(100d), and suppose the anchor x is regular in the sense of Definition 5.3. Fix the local constant M∗ as in (5.13) and take R sufficiently large in terms of those fixed constants. For every available slot a at any site y ∈ BR(x) there is a flow Ja on the available-slot graph such that div Ja = 1{a}, |Ja(e)| ≤ C(1 + dist(e, y))−k , k = d − 1 − dν. (6.4) In particular, P e Ja(e)2 < ∞.
